thread.title: Apple Looking To Brighten iPhone Lineup With New Colors

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Looking To Brighten iPhone Lineup With New Colors
text:
Consumer electronics giant Apple ( AAPL ) is likely to introduce bold new iPhone colors with its smartphone lineup this fall, a respected analyst said Thursday.
X Longtime Apple watcher Ming-Chi Kuo said in a report that the new iPhones will come in a plethora of colors, 9to5Mac reported . Analysts widely expect Apple to release three new handsets in September: a revamped version of the current 5.8-inch OLED-screen iPhone X, as well as a 6.5-inch OLED model and a 6.1-inch LCD model.
Kuo predicted that the 6.5-inch iPhone will come in black, white and a new gold option. He said the 6.1-inch model will debut in "gray, white, blue, red and orange," 9to5Mac said.
Apple's current flagship model, the iPhone X, comes in just two finishes: silver and black, which it calls "space gray." The other new model, the midrange iPhone 8 series, comes in silver, black, gold and red.
IBD Kuo's comments validate a May report from Rosenblatt Securities analyst Jun Zhang. Rosenblatt's Zhang predicted that Apple would use colors to differentiate its 12th-generation handsets from the current models. He predicted the new models would come in such colors as blue, yellow and pink to attract younger consumers.
Flashback To Colorful iPhone 5C The new colors hearken back to the iPhone 5C, which came out in late 2013. That handset was available in five candy colors: blue, green, pink, yellow and white. Since then, Apple has stuck with metallic-tone casings.
Kuo thinks the 6.5-inch OLED iPhone will be priced around $1,000 like the current iPhone X. He expects the 6.1-inch LCD to retail for about $700.
Apple shares rose 0.8% to 185.40 The stock hit an all-time high of 194.20 on June 6, but trended down as the market weakened. It has found support at its 50-day moving average.
